title: Operator Schmidt rank under bounded spectral entangling strength
author: Yuxuan Zhang
status: Complete-original proof candidate; sequential internal review
original_question: Question following Proposition 9 in Kim et al., Phys. Rev. X 16, 041035 (2026)
claim: For fixed time and positive operator-norm error, bounded ancilla-assisted spectral entangling strength gives an O(log(2D)^2) operator Schmidt rank approximation of the full evolution, with arbitrary finite local dimensions and arbitrary local Hamiltonians.
scope_limits: Existence of an operator approximation; no efficient factor-finding algorithm claimed.
The approximating operator need not be unitary.
Independent expert review and formal verification have not been performed.
The full unpublished reference 93 of the original paper was unavailable for comparison; worldwide first-publication priority is not established.

reproduction.interpretation: Supplementary finite controls, not an all-dimensional proof certificate.
